segments.text:
V. 31.
Jeſus ſaith—Namely, the next Day; on Thurſday, in the Morning. Here the Scene, as it were, is opened, for the Diſcourſe which is continued in the following Chapters. Now—While I ſpeak this, the Son of man is glorified—Being fully entered into his glorious Work of Redemption. This evidently relates to the Glory which belongs to his Suffering in ſo holy and victorious a Manner.
